name: Vehla - Native Mac command center with local AI in one hotkey
tagline: What it is Vehla is a native macOS command center for Apple Silicon
description: What it is Vehla is a native macOS command center for Apple Silicon. Open it with a global hotkey and stay in one keyboard-driven palette for apps, files, clipboard, window layouts, notes, and AI — without jumping between a stack of single-purpose utilities. Who it’s for Built for people who already think in shortcuts: writers, engineers, founders, and power users who want local AI nearby, clipboard history that actually helps, and Mac workflows that feel native rather than bolted together.
